segments.cnd13:2.1: Yasmiṃ kāmā na vasantīti yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti na saṃvasanti na āvasanti na parivasantīti –
segments.cnd13:3.1: Taṇhā yassa na vijjatīti taṇhā yassa natthi na sati na saṃvijjati nupalabbhati ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti –
segments.cnd13:4.1: Kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇoti kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo uttiṇṇo nitthiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti –
segments.cnd13:5.1: Vimokkho tassa kīdisoti vimokkho tassa kīdiso kiṃsaṇṭhito kiṃpakāro kiṃpaṭibhāgo icchitabboti vimokkhaṃ pucchatīti –
segments.cnd13:8.7: Yasmiṃ kāmā na vasantīti yasmiṃ kāmā na vasanti na saṃvasanti na āvasanti na parivasantīti –
segments.cnd13:10.2: Taṇhāti rūpataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā.
segments.cnd13:10.4: Taṇhā yassa na vijjatīti taṇhā yassa natthi na sati na saṃvijjati nupalabbhati, pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti –
segments.cnd13:11.1: Kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇoti kathaṃkathā vuccati vicikicchā.
segments.cnd13:11.4: Kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇoti kathaṃkathā ca yo tiṇṇo uttiṇṇo nitthiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti –
segments.cnd13:12.1: Vimokkho tassa nāparoti natthi tassa aparo vimokkho.
segments.cnd13:15.1: Nirāsaso so uda āsasānoti nittaṇho so, udāhu sataṇho rūpe āsīsati [āsiṃsati (syā.)], sadde…pe…
segments.cnd13:15.31: diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbe dhamme āsīsati sādiyati pattheti piheti abhijappatīti –
segments.cnd13:16.2: Paññāṇavā soti paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
segments.cnd13:16.3: Uda paññakappīti udāhu aṭṭhasamāpattiñāṇena vā pañcābhiññāñāṇena vā micchāñāṇena vā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā kappeti janeti sañjaneti nibbatteti abhinibbattetīti –
segments.cnd13:17.4: Atha vā, aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavātipi sakko.
segments.cnd13:17.6: saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hiridhanaṃ ottappadhanaṃ sutadhanaṃ cāgadhanaṃ paññādhanaṃ satipaṭṭhānadhanaṃ sammappadhānadhanaṃ iddhipādadhanaṃ indriyadhanaṃ baladhanaṃ bojjhaṅgadhanaṃ maggadhanaṃ phaladhanaṃ nibbānadhananti.
segments.cnd13:17.7: Tehi anekavidhehi dhanaratanehi aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavātipi sakko.
segments.cnd13:17.8: Atha vā, pahu visavī alamatto sūro vīro vikkanto abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃsotipi sakko.
segments.cnd13:17.9: Muniṃ ahaṃ sakka yathā vijaññanti sakka yathāhaṃ muniṃ jāneyyaṃ ājāneyyaṃ vijāneyyaṃ paṭivijāneyyaṃ paṭivijjheyyanti –
segments.cnd13:18.2: Tanti yaṃ pucchāmi yaṃ yācāmi yaṃ ajjhesāmi yaṃ pasādemi.
segments.cnd13:18.3: Viyācikkhāti ācikkhāhi desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehi.
segments.cnd13:21.5: diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbe dhamme nāsīsati na icchati na sādiyati na pattheti na piheti nābhijappatīti –
segments.cnd13:22.2: Paññāṇavāti paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
segments.cnd13:22.3: Na ca paññakappīti aṭṭhasamāpattiñāṇena vā pañcābhiññāñāṇena vā micchāñāṇena vā taṇhākappaṃ vā na kappeti diṭṭhikappaṃ vā na kappeti na janeti na sañjaneti na nibbatteti nābhinibbattetīti –
segments.cnd13:23.2: Munīti monaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ…pe… saṅgajālamaticca so muni.
segments.cnd13:23.3: Evampi todeyya muniṃ vijānāti todeyya, evaṃ muniṃ jāna paṭijāna paṭivijāna paṭivijjhāti –
segments.cnd13:24.2: Akiñcananti rāgakiñcanaṃ dosakiñcanaṃ mohakiñcanaṃ mānakiñcanaṃ diṭṭhikiñcanaṃ kilesakiñcanaṃ duccaritakiñcanaṃ.
segments.cnd13:24.3: Yassetāni [yassete (syā.)] kiñcanāni [kiñcanā (syā.)] pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭippassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni, so vuccati akiñcano.
segments.cnd13:25.1: Akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattanti akiñcanaṃ puggalaṃ kāme ca bhave ca asattaṃ alaggaṃ alaggitaṃ apalibuddhaṃ nikkhantaṃ nissaṭaṃ vippamuttaṃ visaññuttaṃ vimariyādikatena cetasā viharantanti –

lines: Navame todeyyasutte – vimokkho tassa kīdisoti tassa kīdiso vimokkho icchitabboti pucchati. 58.
Idānissa aññavimokkhābhāvaṃ dassento bhagavā dutiyaṃ gāthamāha.
Tattha vimokkho tassa nāparoti tassa añño vimokkho natthi. 59.
Evaṃ “taṇhakkhayo eva vimokkho”ti vuttepi tamatthaṃ asallakkhento “nirāsaso so uda āsasāno”ti puna pucchati.
Tattha uda paññakappīti udāhu samāpattiñāṇādinā ñāṇena taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā kappayati. 60.
Athassa bhagavā taṃ ācikkhanto catutthaṃ gāthamāha.
Rūpe nāsīsatīti catusamuṭṭhānike rūpārammaṇe chandarāgavasena na pattheti.
Palibodhaṭṭhena rāgo eva kiñcanaṃ rāgakiñcanaṃ madanaṭṭhena vā.

after.title: Todeyyamāṇavasuttaniddesavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ bhagavā idampi suttaṃ arahattanikūṭeneva desesi, desanāpariyosāne ca pubbasadiso eva dhammābhisamayo ahosīti.
